# Kimochi

> Kimochi is a free, open-source (GPL-3.0) desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux for language learners that reads the text on your screen with OCR (games, visual novels, manga, videos, any app), draws it back over whatever you're reading, and lets you hover any word to look it up (Yomitan or Hachidori; for Japanese also 10ten) and make Anki cards. It was built for Japanese, which is still the best supported; you can also set it to 48 other left-to-right languages (Korean, Chinese, Spanish, French, German and more), which are experimental as of November 2026. Hachidori reads about twenty languages besides Japanese (experimental), each with its own dictionaries. Some features stay Japanese-only: the MeikiOCR and Manga OCR engines, the 10ten dictionary, read aloud, word audio, and furigana and pitch-accent card fields. Translations and AI explanations are in English. With Text hooking it can also read a Windows game's text straight from the game, on Windows and, through Proton or Wine, on Linux (NixOS's Steam included) and the Steam Deck. It also has a Gaming Mode for the Steam Deck, read with the controller, with a radial menu whose actions, buttons and colours you choose (PlayStation button names on DualSense and DualShock pads). Since 1.1.0 it has a Stats tab (a reading heatmap with streaks, characters and time per day, reading speed, most-read kanji) and keeps every line read, exportable for exSTATic or as CSV or JSON; Transparent hover cards and a dictionary opacity setting so the game shows through; lookups with the middle, back or forward mouse button (not on Linux with Wayland) or on hover with no key; and Auto Game Pausing, which freezes the game while you look a word up (experimental, opt-in, not every game). On Linux, Kimochi lists windows itself on GNOME, KDE Plasma 6, Hyprland, Sway 1.12+, COSMIC and Niri; the overlay is tested on KDE Plasma 6, Hyprland (Omarchy), Sway and GNOME 46 to 51. Made by Hamish Macpherson, an independent developer in Canada. As of November 2026 the latest release is 1.1.0, from 18 November 2026.

Kimochi is not the "Kimochi" emotions journal, the "Kimochi" AI companion app or the Kimochis toys. Kimochi itself is free with no account. Kimochi Cloud is optional and paid (prices as of October 2026, in US dollars): $6 a month, $60 a year (two months free, so $5 a month) or $125 once for lifetime, with a 14-day free trial. It adds in-app translation, AI explanations, ElevenLabs read-aloud, Google Vision cloud OCR and sync. The app has no analytics, telemetry, crash reporting or ads.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kimochiapp.com/): what Kimochi does, features, how it works, pricing
- [FAQ](https://kimochiapp.com/faq): short answers about languages, platforms, price, privacy, OCR engines, dictionaries, Anki
- [Compare](https://kimochiapp.com/compare): when to pick Kimochi, GameSentenceMiner, owocr or YomiNinja
- [Install on Linux](https://kimochiapp.com/download/linux): Steam Deck, Ubuntu and Debian, other distributions
- [Text hooking on Linux and Steam Deck](https://kimochiapp.com/linux-steam-deck-text-hooker): hooking Windows games run through Proton or Wine (Steam, Lutris, Bottles, Heroic) with LunaHook, with Textractor as its fallback, including in Steam Deck Gaming Mode; a Textractor alternative with no Wine-prefix setup
- [Privacy](https://kimochiapp.com/privacy): exactly what leaves your computer, feature by feature
- [Terms](https://kimochiapp.com/terms)
- [Documentation](https://docs.kimochiapp.com/): installing on each platform, OCR engines, the overlay, dictionaries, the Log and Notebook, Anki, controllers, Kimochi Cloud, settings, shortcuts and troubleshooting

## Community

- [Discord](https://discord.gg/vdMge6TBZQ): help, feedback, feature ideas and release news, with the developer
- [GitHub](https://github.com/hamstu/kimochi): source code (GPL-3.0), releases and issues
- Downloads: the installers, updates and the files the app downloads later come from https://downloads.kimochiapp.com (Kimochi's own server), with GitHub as the fallback
